evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies Tor control protocol handling in src/torcontrol.cpp.
rationale: Validating Tor control replies and cached keys prevents command and argument injection into the Tor control socket. As noted in the description, unescaped CRLF or space characters allow an unprivileged local process to exploit an unavailable Tor port, seed the key cache, and issue commands like 'SIGNAL SHUTDOWN' when Tor reconnects.
